workflows.name: Create Workflow
workflows.description: User creates a new workflow from scratch or from a template.
steps: System creates a draft workflow with initial trigger node.
User is redirected to the visual editor.

workflows.name: Edit Workflow
workflows.description: User edits nodes and connections in the visual editor.
steps: User drags nodes from palette onto canvas.
System validates invariants and updates workflow.

workflows.name: Activate Workflow
workflows.description: User activates a workflow to start execution.
steps: User clicks 'Activate' on a draft workflow.
System schedules executions based on triggers.

workflows.name: Generate Workflow with AI
workflows.description: User uses AI to generate a workflow from a description.
steps: User enters a description of the process.
System sends description to AI service.
User reviews and edits the draft.
